# ReservoirStateProjection

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The mapping of input signals onto a high-dimensional state space of a physical reservoir, where linear readouts can recover the original waveform or its features. Provides a neuromorphic-friendly, analog-domain computation primitive that aligns with in-network processing and event-driven data flows.
